id: # The 19 tactics of military-units-and-tactics.md (manual p.15; guide book p.17, p.35). One row for each tactic.
# unit_types: the classes of unit_types.tsv that use it. grade: the aptitude that the unit needs (B, A, S, or any). morale, range: documented.

# pattern: single (the target), line (the target and the hexes between: 貫箭), front3 (the target and its two neighbours next to the unit: 橫掃), around (the six hexes around the unit: 旋風), splash (the target and the six hexes around it: 亂射).

# effect: knock (the target moves value hexes away), pull (the target moves value hexes toward the unit), advance (knock, then the unit moves into the free hex), pass (the unit moves to the far side of the target), confuse, fire, none.
# damage_percent: the damage against a normal attack (assumed, Q-172). targets: units, buildings, ships (| list). always_success: documented for the tower (Steam guide).
